q_pain: How much does your knee hurt?
redTitle: Contact your doctor or hospital now
redBody: You reported a warning sign. Do not wait for your next visit. In an emergency call 112.
thanksBody: Your physio can see your check-in.
voiceHint: Say e.g. "pain 4, swelling same, did all my exercises, squat was hard, no fever"
voiceUnsupported: Voice is not supported in this browser. Please use the buttons.
voiceError: Could not hear you. Try again or use the buttons.
notice: Supports clinical judgement; not a diagnosis. Your physio decides your plan.
noticeLong: This app helps your physio keep an eye on your recovery. It does not diagnose anything and does not replace your physio or doctor. If you feel unwell, contact them.
w_ext_hint: Lie on your tummy with your legs off the end of the bed. Measure how much higher the operated heel sits (cm). 0 = same.
w_flex: How far can you bend it?
w_flex_hint: Slide your heel towards your bottom. Type the angle in degrees.
w_photo: Add a photo of the bend (optional)
photoSoon: Photos are not uploaded yet. Your physio will see them in the full version.
w_circ: Is the knee bigger than the other one?
w_circ_hint: Tape around the middle of each kneecap. Type how many cm bigger the operated knee is.
w_slr: Does your knee sag or bend when you lift the straight leg?
w_balOpen: Balance on operated leg, eyes open (seconds)
w_balClosed: Balance on operated leg, eyes closed (seconds)
videoSoon: Videos are not uploaded yet. Your physio will review them in the full version.
tskIntro: How much do you agree with each sentence?
tsk_1: I'm afraid I might hurt my knee again if I exercise.
tsk_2: If I push through the discomfort, my knee will probably get worse.
tsk_3: My body is telling me something is seriously wrong with my knee.
tsk_4: My pain would probably get worse if I exercised.
tsk_5: Pain is a signal to stop so that I do not injure myself.
tsk_6: It is not really safe for someone with a knee like mine to be active.
tsk_7: I cannot do what other people do because I could easily get hurt.
tsk_8: The safest thing I can do is avoid every unnecessary movement.
tsk_9: I would not have this much pain if something serious were not going on.
tsk_10: Exercise makes it more likely that I will hurt my knee again.
tsk_11: I should not exercise when I am in pain.
fearNudge: You said you were scared. Please answer 11 short questions so your physio can help you.
